name: buffalo_calf
about: A calf of the water buffalo of Việt Nam (nghé): some months old, about 0.8 m at the withers, long legs, a large head, gray brown with a soft coat, horns that only start.
sources: A calf of a swamp buffalo of Việt Nam (nghé): the numbers of the shape are a guess (a young animal has longer legs and a larger head for its body than an adult), not a measurement. The template is a bull without its horns.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess, not a measurement.
